data.explanation: Your employer is raising your contracted weekly hours from 32 to 40, starting 1 January 2027, and will adjust your salary to match. An amendment to your employment contract is enclosed for you to review. Sign both copies and send one back to People & Culture by the stated date so payroll can process the change in time for January. If you do not return it, the change may not be applied correctly from January. If you have questions about the new salary figure, ask People & Culture before signing.
